map.按齐奥尔科夫斯基公式 Δv=Ve·ln(m0/mf) 计算火箭速度增量，输入比冲: Compute rocket velocity increment with the Tsiolkovsky equation Δv=Ve·ln(m0/mf), entering specific impulse plus initial and final mass to assess orbit insertion and transfer capability, suiting overall rocket design and orbit manoeuvre estimation.
map.单级火箭速度增量：Δv = Isp·g₀·ln(m₀/m_f)。: Single-stage rocket velocity increment: Δv = Isp·g₀·ln(m₀/m_f).
map.给定目标 Δv（如入轨需约 9.4 km/s），反推所需质量比或比冲。: Given a target Δv (about 9.4 km/s for orbit insertion), back out the required mass ratio or specific impulse.
map.评估上面级能否把载荷送入目标轨道。: Assess whether the upper stage can deliver the payload into the target orbit.
map.：比冲 Isp=300 s、初始质量 m₀=500 t、最终质量 m_f=100: : specific impulse Isp=300 s, initial mass m₀=500 t, final mass m_f=100 t. Δv = 300×9.81×ln(500/100) = 2943×ln(5) = 2943×1.609 ≈ 4733 m/s ≈ 4.73 km/s. Far short of orbit for a single stage, so staging is required.
map.由动压、阻力系数与面积求阻力: Drag from dynamic pressure, drag coefficient and area
map.由空气密度与速度求动压: Dynamic pressure from air density and velocity
map.由引力常数与半径求逃逸速度: Escape velocity from gravitational constant and radius
map.为什么单级火箭很难入轨？: Why is it hard for a single-stage rocket to reach orbit?
map.入轨需 Δv≈9.4 km/s（含重力/阻力损失更多）。由公式，Δv 随质量比对: Orbit needs Δv≈9.4 km/s (more with gravity and drag losses). From the formula Δv grows with the logarithm of the mass ratio, so lifting 4.7 to 9.4 needs the mass ratio to rise from 5 to 25, which the structure cannot bear — hence multistaging with progressive jettison.
map.标准重力加速度 9.80665 m/s²，仅作 Isp（秒）转排气速度的单位换算: Standard gravity 9.80665 m/s² is only the unit conversion constant for turning Isp (seconds) into exhaust velocity, unrelated to the actual g at the launch site.
